products.title: Ferryl Ferrycid Rust Remover
products.descriptionShort: Ferryl Ferrycid removes heavy rust, rust scale and rust stains on paintwork, and also limescale, cement and dirt on wooden decks and sanitary fittings — diluted with water to suit the job. 25 L, 10 L or 1 L.
products.descriptionLong:
Ships usually carry several chemicals for rust — one for heavy scale, one for stains, another for paintwork. Ferryl Ferrycid covers the range with one product, diluted with water according to how bad the rust is.

What it does

  • Heavy rust and rust scale. Ferrycid acts quickly on light rust and, given time, removes heavy rust completely. Badly corroded parts can be left in a Ferrycid bath. Ferryl states that it reacts with the rust, not the steel; on heavy rust it leaves an inert white powder that is brushed or rinsed away before coating.
  • Rust stains on paintwork. Applied early, it stops the staining and removes it without fading the paint, and leaves a thin protective layer. After rinsing, the surface can be touched up or repainted with no further treatment.
  • Cleaning. Limescale and cement deposits, painted surfaces, wooden outer decks and sanitary installations.

Surfaces

Iron and steel, painted surfaces, wood, ceramic, plastic, vinyl and glass.

How to apply it

By brush, rag, mop, spray, pouring, pressure washer or submersion, then rinse with fresh water. Wear suitable gloves and eye protection.

Next step

Protect cleaned stainless steel with Ferryl 401; protect cleaned spare parts with Ferryl 103 drying oil.

Packs

25 L or 10 L plastic drum, or 1 L plastic bottle.

products.title: Ferryl Rustoil Penetrating Oil
products.descriptionShort: Ferryl Rustoil is a thin penetrating oil that frees seized bolts, shackles and lashings, washes old grease and moisture out of wire rope before re-greasing, and leaves a light protective film. 10 L can or 450 ml aerosol.
products.descriptionLong:
Ferryl Rustoil is a very thin oil that creeps into threads, joints and the core of a wire rope. It loosens rust, dried oil and old grease, displaces water and moisture, lubricates, and leaves a thin film that holds off fresh rust.

Two main jobs

  • Freeing seized parts — screws and bolts, shackles, chains and lashings, latches, locks, hinges, springs, valves, wheels and machine parts.
  • Preparing used or rusty wire rope. Brushed or wiped on, it dissolves the old grease, loosens rust and drives moisture out of the core, so the new coat of Ferryl 101 oil or Ferryl 202 grease does not seal rust and water in.

Properties

  • Penetrates easily.
  • Loosens rust, oil and grease.
  • Displaces water and moisture.
  • Protects against rust and lubricates.
  • Non-corrosive and non-conductive; safe on all metals and painted surfaces.

How to apply it

By spray, rag, brush, pouring or submersion.

Packs

10 litre metal can, or 450 ml aerosol.

Fuel oil, lube oil and diesel, mineral oils, grease and fats, dirt, soot, carbon, asphalt and wax.

Where it is used

Decks, machinery, engine rooms, cargo holds and tanks. It is also how Ferryl 103 drying oil is taken off a spare part when it goes back into service.

Properties

  • Non-chlorinated.

How to apply it

By rag, brush, spray, mop, sponge or submersion.

Pack

25 litre metal drum.

products.title: Ferryl Electroclean Electrical Equipment Cleaner
products.descriptionShort: Ferryl Electroclean is a non-conductive, high-flashpoint cleaner that dissolves oil, grease and dirt from motors, generators, switchgear, relays and contacts and evaporates to a dry, film-free surface. 25 L drum or 450 ml aerosol.
products.descriptionLong:
Electrical equipment cannot be washed with water or an ordinary degreaser. Ferryl Electroclean is made for it: it is non-conductive, dissolves oil, grease and dirt, gets into small parts and tight spaces, and evaporates quickly to leave the surface clean, dry and free of film. Its high flashpoint makes it safer to use around machinery than low-flashpoint solvents.

Where it is used

Motors and generators, switchgear, switches and relays, contacts and coils, electronics, alarms, electrical cables and compressors. Like Cleaning Fluid, it also removes Ferryl 103 drying oil from stored parts.

Properties

  • Non-conductive.
  • Strong dissolving power for oil, grease and dirt.
  • High flashpoint.
  • Penetrates small parts and narrow gaps.
  • Quick evaporation, no residue film.
  • Non-corrosive; safe on all metals and alloys and most painted or varnished surfaces.
  • Non-chlorinated.

How to apply it

By rag, brush, spray or submersion. Isolate equipment before cleaning.

Packs

25 litre metal drum, or 450 ml aerosol.

products.title: Ferryl Air-Refreshment Bad Odour Neutraliser
products.descriptionShort: Ferryl Air-Refreshment neutralises the bacteria and particles behind bad smells in cargo holds, containers, galleys, cabins and garbage areas, instead of masking them. Non-flammable. 25 L or 500 ml spray bottle.
products.descriptionLong:
An ordinary air freshener covers a bad smell with a stronger pleasant one; the cause stays, and in a cargo hold it can taint the next cargo. Where it is used

Cargo holds and containers after odorous cargoes, storage rooms, processing facilities and factories, garbage-disposal areas, galleys, mess rooms, cabins, bathrooms and toilets, the bridge, and fishing vessels. It deals with fish and animal smells, waste, cigarette smoke and mildew.

How to apply it

Spray evenly into the air — with spraying equipment in holds and large spaces, or the hand-pump bottle in small ones.

Properties

  • Removes bad odours actively.
  • Neutralises bacteria in the air.
  • Fresh, neutral scent.
  • Non-flammable.
  • Non-aerosol spray bottle.

Packs

25 L plastic drum, or 500 ml spray bottle, single or in packs of 10.
